title: Publish Spotticus as AnthusAI/Spotticus
description: Publish the working Spotticus repository as the public GitHub project AnthusAI/Spotticus. Preserve the existing develop branch and current Antigravity/Cursor fixture change. Definition of Done: target repository exists publicly, current history is pushed, origin is configured, and the resulting repository URL is recorded.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Started publication. Verified this checkout has no remote, GitHub authentication is available, and no tracked secret-like files were found. The existing bin/codexbar modification is the current fixture selection and will be preserved.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Published successfully at https://github.com/AnthusAI/Spotticus. Repository is public, origin points to git@github.com:AnthusAI/Spotticus.git, and develop is pushed and tracking origin/develop. The current bin/codexbar fixture selection is included in commit cfbdd63. Kanbus local records remain untracked and were intentionally not published.
